newsitem.title: GHANA: Bearish market again on Ghana Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Bearish market again on Ghana Bourse.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange was bearish on Monday, but there was an improvememt in volume, the official market report said.

The All-share index lost 0.17 point and closed at 384.46, down from 384.63 on Friday. The two risers were Enterprise Insurance Company, up five cedis to 520 cedis and trading company CFAO CFAO.GH, up four cedis to 24 cedis. The only decliner was Ghana Commercial Bank GCB.GH, down three cedis to 662 cedis.
The total of shares traded was 75,330, up from 42,140 on Friday. Bids outpaced offers by 4,776,960 to 288,230.
